description:
Project Overview

The Sensory Science and Eating Behaviour group at Wageningen is recruiting a PhD researcher to study how food properties influence children’s eating behaviour and energy intake. The position is based within Human Nutrition and Health.

Research Position Overview

Design and conduct experimental studies with children, apply digital approaches to measuring eating behaviour and analyse behavioural and nutritional data. The project combines sensory science, human research and quantitative analysis.

Research Areas

  • Child nutrition
  • Eating behaviour
  • Sensory science
  • Energy intake
